title: All infinite faces close against one earned physical contract
statement: For every k>=3 and positive fixed rates, the exact raw ordered cycle is irreducible on N^3, nonexplosive and positive recurrent, with unique pi and Epi[(1+q)exp(rM)] finite for every r>0. Explicit B/C/A deletion words have length<=2k+1 and prefix overshoot<=6k-5. For rational1<u<t choose W=t^M,F=(1+q)u^M and slow section Z={A0}union{B=C=0}. The first-degradation-or-k-jump normalizer has uniform strict W contraction outside an acquired finite box, including high A/low B/low C; actual ratios q_i/q_j=(kappa_i/kappa_j)/(x-yi)_(yj-yi) pay every competitor. It constructs finite normlike Voff=E[whole F occupation+actual VZ landing]<=W before face pasting. Plane VZ=t^(B+C)[1+f_B/(M+1)], axis VZ=t^A, head values0. The finite decreasing profile is acquired from real low-B conversion p_b through f_b-f_(b+1)=G/p_b,closed form without enumerating its enormous index set. Low-C deletion, full unbounded plane overruns and every outward/low-inventory exit are received at this same V,not a stationary fiber or unearned boundary oracle. On the axis, first source-gap-one errors repay borrowed inventories before stopping; complete first-order drift=(kappa_(k-1)/kappa_k)(1/t-1)/A<0,whole O(A^-2) remainder and clocks paid. One later head closes every chart without circular choices. Regeneration proves the stated full physical occupation and activity result; no unrestricted-list theorem follows.

requires: Three free count inventories, ordinary integer falling-factorial propensities kappa_i(x)_yi with all fixed kappa_i>0; exact ordered grammar and no hidden factorial divisors.

The theorem covers real positive rates; certificate acquisition uses positive rational rates and rational1<u<t. Unsupported lists return UNKNOWN. Old N1567 sufficient terminal-gap family remains distinct.
provides: Exact statement above, at the stated contract.
costs: Acquired rational chart/profile constants, finite integer head, explicit deletion paths and exact factored reward bounds; Voff is proved bounded,not numerically evaluated. Huge powers/head are not expanded/enumerated.
k4 rates(1,1,1,1,2) head about2.86e45; no useful tail/mixing computation or practical crossover. Ordinary product-Poisson reward is much sharper on the complex-balanced locus.
contract.units: Physical holding time, genuine jump activity q, inventory M=A+B+C, stationary reward and return-time moments are separate. All rates positive and fixed; mathematical count processes only.
contract.obstruction: Complete same-principal family proof, without independent review or priority clearance. General weak-reversibility recurrence remains open. Stationary exponential count/activity rewards and all polynomial physical returns coexist with NO positive exponential physical return moment. No practical crossover; chemistry non-operational.
